name: PFAS
summary: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances are a diverse chemical class. Persistence, exposure, toxicokinetics, and biological effects vary by compound; the Atlas will keep those distinctions explicit.

name: Bisphenols
summary: A family including BPA and related compounds studied for interactions with hormone signaling and for exposure from selected materials and products.

name: Phthalates
summary: A group of chemicals used in several material and product applications. Exposure patterns and endocrine-related evidence differ substantially among individual phthalates and metabolites.

name: PCBs
summary: Polychlorinated biphenyls are persistent legacy pollutants. Although U.S. manufacture was banned decades ago, environmental persistence keeps them relevant to exposure science.

name: Selected pesticides
summary: Pesticides span many chemical families and modes of action. Endocrine activity must be evaluated substance by substance rather than generalized to every pesticide.

name: Flame retardants
summary: Flame retardants comprise several chemical classes with different uses, persistence profiles, exposure routes, and biological evidence.
